recognize_zh: 單一中小型淋巴細胞，細胞核圓、染色質細緻，周圍一圈淡藍灰色細胞質向外伸出許多細長毛髮狀突起（hairy projections），是毛細胞白血病（hairy cell leukemia）的典型毛細胞。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cell, about 1.5-2 times the diameter of a red cell
Round, centrally placed nucleus with moderately condensed, stippled chromatin and no prominent nucleolus
Moderate amount of pale blue-gray cytoplasm
Background red cells unremarkable apart from mild drying artifact
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at oil immersion shows a medium-sized lymphoid cell with a round nucleus, finely clumped chromatin without a conspicuous nucleolus, and a moderate rim of pale blue-gray cytoplasm. The cytoplasmic border bears numerous fine, circumferential hair-like projections. The surrounding red cells show no specific abnormality. Findings are consistent with a hairy cell of hairy cell leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123 positive) and/or BRAF V600E testing is recommended.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: HCL-v cells have a prominent central nucleolus, higher WBC without monocytopenia, and are CD25-negative and BRAF V600E wild-type.
SMZL villous lymphocytes show short, polar (bipolar) villi rather than fine circumferential projections and lack CD103/CD25/annexin A1.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL cells have broad-based, unevenly distributed villi and are usually CD25- and annexin A1-negative.

ddx.dx: Monocyte or reactive lymphocyte with drying artifact
ddx.vs: Monocytes have folded nuclei with gray vacuolated cytoplasm, and artifactual cytoplasmic fraying is irregular rather than evenly distributed fine hairs.
